Under §11008(c) of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for Fiscal Year 2023, an "Applicant" is defined as:

> “the term ‘applicant’ means a person that submits an application to the Secretary of Defense for a grant or cooperative agreement under this section.”

This means that any individual, organization, or entity that applies for a grant or cooperative agreement under the provisions of §11008 is considered an "Applicant" for the purposes of that section. The term is specifically tied to the application process for funding under the relevant provisions of the NDAA.

For further context, §11008 generally pertains to the establishment of a program to support research and development in artificial intelligence (AI) and related technologies, with a focus on national security and defense applications. The definition of "Applicant" is part of the administrative framework for managing this program.
